components.name: AS568 D O-rings
components.source: ISO 3601-1:2012 (5th edition, incl. Cor 1:2012) = DIN ISO 3601-1:2013-11. Amd 1:2019 not verified. (Fluid power systems - O-rings - Part 1: Inside diameters, cross-sections, tolerances and designation codes); https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/58043/f1be17df93fc436ca4e10e4cc09bf030/ISO-3601-1-2012.pdf (official ISO 3601-1:2012 preview: clauses 6-7, Table 1 and Tables 2-3 up to code 134, used to confirm structure, class A/B tolerances and d2 tolerances); https://dichtomatik.fst.com/-/media/files/dichtomatik/solution-sheets/en/dichtomatik_o-ring-tolerances.pdf (FST/Dichtomatik: all 349 industrial codes per DIN ISO 3601-1:2013-11, d1, class B tolerance, d2, d2 tolerance); https://www.prepol.com/documents/o-ring-sizes-iso3601 (Prepol 'ISO 3601 O-ring sizes' 2024: industrial codes 004-475 with class A d1 tolerance, and the 360 metric aerospace codes with d1 tolerance and d2 tolerance); https://www.allsealsinc.com/simrit-pdfs/AS568.pdf (Simrit AS568 table: d1/d2 and tolerances in mm, cross-check for class A); https://www.globaloring.com/as568-size-chart/ (Global O-Ring AS568 chart: d1/d2 mm and d1 tolerance, cross-check for class A); https://www.globaloring.com/iso-3601-metric-orings/ (Global O-Ring ISO 3601 metric list: code, d1, d2 for metric codes, cross-check); https://www.globaloring.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/International-O-Ring-Size-Standards.pdf (code system explanation: industrial code = AS568 dash number; metric code = cross-section group letter + d1 in 0.1 mm); https://www.thisoldtractor.com/o-rings_iso36011.html (Gregory Bender ISO 3601-1 table: code, d1, d2, cross-check)
